entries.name: Product Description Analysis
entries.intent: Identify correct information from a product description.

variationTips: Change the time period or conditions.

entries.name: Production Time Calculation
entries.intent: Calculate the minimum time required for the production of the first item.
entries.stemPattern: 위 생산 계획을 다음 [조건]에 따라 수행할 경우 8월 1일 첫 번째 의자가 생산될 때까지 걸리는 최소 시간으로 옳은 것은?

variationTips: Use different products or production conditions.
